scope: Phase B engineering correction for explicit fixed-point rounding names, independent boundary references, widened RTL rounding arithmetic, and separation of historical audit from current cache reuse; no formal research experiment

root_cause.naming: The historical rne implementation rounds ties toward positive infinity rather than to even; historical trunc is an arithmetic right shift and therefore floors negative values rather than truncating toward zero.
root_cause.rtl: The generated signed RTL added the half-unit bias at the original signal width. Positive values near the upper boundary could wrap before the arithmetic shift, unlike the unbounded Python integer model.

first_diagnostic_failures.interpretation: Boundary diagnostics only; not paper performance results.

changes.result: New plans, constructors, and proposer domains use nearest_ties_to_pos_inf and floor. Historical aliases remain input-only compatibility values.
Signed rounding expressions sign-extend by one bit before adding the bias and shifting.
Quotient/remainder reference checks signed values, positive and negative ties, saturation, wrapping, sign extension, and compiled Verilog expressions without reusing the implementation algorithm.
Frozen Stage C and pilot artifacts remain read-only auditable through explicit legacy_v1 replay, while current cache and calibration paths reject the changed candidate or RTL identity.

verification.command: python3 -m pytest -q $(rg --files tests | rg '/test_search_ir_.*\.py$') tests/test_numeric_semantics.py tests/test_cic_bittrue.py

verification.observed_summary: RTL_EQUIV: PASS; six legacy DDC candidates each reported mismatch=0/2016
72 state transitions replayed and 37 area sources checked under legacy_v1

evidence_boundary: The historical artifacts and paper numbers were not overwritten.
Historical area and calibration values are not reusable for the corrected RTL identity.
No PPA comparison or search-benefit claim is made from this correction.
Future synthesis, calibration, or search using the corrected generator requires a new run id.
